description: Source file implementing AppNotifications functionality, including subscription management, event emission, cleanup, and internal classes for handling notifications and Thunder subscriptions within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing app notification handling, subscription, emission, cleanup, and internal management.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation::SubscriberMap
classes.description: Manages subscribers for notifications, including adding, removing, event updates, and dispatching.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation::ThunderSubscriptionManager
classes.description: Handles Thunder plugin subscriptions and unsubscriptions, managing registered notifications.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription requests for notifications, managing internal maps and Thunder subscriptions.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Emits a notification event with payload and appId.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up notifications associated with a specific connectionId and origin.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided shell interface.

methods.name: CleanupNotifications
methods.description: Removes notifications matching connectionId and origin from subscriber map.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber to the map.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the map.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves subscribers for a given key.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the subscriber map.

methods.name: EventUpdate
methods.description: Dispatches an event update to relevant subscribers, filtering by appId if provided.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches notification to either gateway or launch delegate based on origin.

methods.name: DispatchToGateway
methods.description: Sends notification to the app gateway responder.

methods.name: DispatchToLaunchDelegate
methods.description: Sends notification to the internal launch delegate responder.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to Thunder notifications for a module and event.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from Thunder notifications for a module and event.

methods.name: HandleNotifier
methods.description: Handles registration or unregistration of notifications with Thunder plugin.

methods.name: RegisterNotification
methods.description: Registers a notification with Thunder plugin and tracks it.

methods.name: UnregisterNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a notification from Thunder plugin and updates tracking.

methods.name: IsNotificationRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a notification is already registered.
